verdict.rationale: Data region or residency selection is a fair question for a cloud browser SaaS, but nothing in the evidence documents choosing where session data, recordings or profiles are stored. The proxy feature (docs-13) only routes browser traffic through different geographic locations. That is an adjacent network control, not data-storage residency, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
